title: assure.AttestationStore
description: An interface: HandOver writes a proof run's predicate where the provider's attestation action reads it, always outside the product's repository, so the provider signs it with the commit as subject and keeps it; Fetch reads back every bundle the provider keeps for a commit, which VerifyAttestation checks before a gate reads it. The product's repository holds nothing.

title: assure.DecisionStore
description: An interface: Keep writes a decision to the CI job's output, and HandOver writes a passed release decision as the decision.json predicate where the provider's attestation action reads it, and refuses any other decision. JobOutput prints the decision's text on the job's log and appends it to the job's step summary, and writes the predicate to the file the job names, all outside the product's repository; its Check refuses, before a gate decides, an output inside the repository and a file already at the predicate's path.

title: appbuild.ResolveDependencies
description: ResolveDependencies runs Go's module tools on the captured source and saves go.mod and go.sum through the apply journal.

title: appbuild.Download
description: Download writes the zips and module-cache.json into a new folder, and the build reads that record back.

title: appbuild.Build
description: Build writes build.json and the executable into a new result folder.

title: appbuild.BuildImage
description: BuildImage writes the OCI layout and image.json into a new folder; PublishImage and RetrieveImage move it to and from a registry.

title: parser.ParseServiceDeclaration
description: ParseServiceDeclaration reads a declaration from its file through the strict decoder in strict.go. STEGO writes a declaration only when it scaffolds one; an author or an agent changes it by editing the file.

title: lifecycle.Store
description: Not written yet: STEGO keeps no digest lifecycle today. It will read the lifecycle records from the registry's current head and write them beside the registry.

title: runs_at
description: runs_at, run_jobs, run_artifacts and tag_ref read the release's runs, jobs, artifacts and tag at one commit from GitHub. qualify writes the qualification record to a new result folder.

title: verification.verify
description: verify authenticates the compiler and its build record, then copies both into the new result folder.

title: delivery.LoadRequirements
description: Reconcile adds deploy/platform-requirements.yaml to the plan, and commitTransaction in internal/compiler/transaction.go writes it through the apply journal and records its digest under project_files in .stego/state.yaml, so git holds the aggregate, apply refuses a hand edit and drift names one. LoadRequirements reads the file back through the strict decoder: one document of at most 1 MiB, with no alias and no unknown field, of format version 1, each requirement of a known kind with the shape of its kind.

title: delivery.LoadPipeline
description: The compiler writes the CI file as a project file through the apply journal and records its digest under project_files in .stego/state.yaml. LoadPipeline reads the file back through the strict decoder, in the shape that STEGO writes for the provider and no other.

title: delivery.LoadBase
description: The compiler writes the files of the base as project files through the apply journal and records each digest under project_files in .stego/state.yaml. LoadBase reads the files of a base back and holds them to plain kustomize: a kustomization with only its resources, each a file of the base folder. The tests build the base with the kustomize library; the stego binary does not carry it, so that it stays in the size limit of the compiler artifact.

title: delivery.LoadApplicationSet
description: The compiler writes deploy/argocd/applicationset.yaml as a project file through the apply journal and records its digest under project_files in .stego/state.yaml; Argo CD pulls it from git, and STEGO never applies it. LoadApplicationSet reads the file back through the strict decoder, in the shape that STEGO writes and no other.

title: delivery.LoadCheckRecord
description: Not written yet. SaveCheckRecord writes delivery-check.json into a new result folder with an exclusive create, as appbuild.Build writes build.json. The pipeline hands the file to the provider's signer as the attestation predicate, so the signed attestation on the image is the durable record; STEGO keeps no store of its own. LoadCheckRecord reads the file back through the strict decoder and checks its digest.

title: fill.ParseFill
description: ParseFill reads fills/<name>/fill.yaml through the strict decoder, and refuses evidence or a sign-off with a missing field. WriteEvidence and WriteSignOff write one section of the manifest and keep the rest.

title: compiler.LoadState
description: LoadState reads .stego/state.yaml through the strict decoder, and decodeState refuses a record that breaks its rules. SaveState writes it, and commitTransaction in transaction.go saves the record last, after the generated files.

title: registry.LoadDirectories
description: LoadDirectories captures one through eight registry sources, refuses an artifact or an input file that occurs in more than one source, and indexes every archetype, component and mixin. STEGO never writes a registry; a platform engineer changes it by editing its files.

title: Registry.Archetype
description: LoadDirectories parses each archetypes/<name>/archetype.yaml and each mixin, and Registry.Archetype and Registry.Mixin return them by name.

title: registry.LoadPorts
description: Not written yet: a port exists today only as a name on the components that require or provide it. This names where a port with its meaning and fields will load from.

title: Registry.checkSlots
description: LoadDirectories reads each component's and each mixin's slots with the component, and checkSlots finds the protobuf contract of each one.
